svg.title: G5 Validation and release: integrated process map
svg.desc: Process map of phase G5 Validation and release: REL-01 Assembly, installation and commissioning instructions (DIY-kit build) (Joint, after nothing); REL-02 Operation, maintenance and decommissioning (Joint, after nothing); REL-03 Information for use, markings and warnings (Risk assessment, after REL-02); REL-04 Safety validation on the robot (Safety-related control, after nothing); REL-05 Unknown scenarios and field trials (Risk assessment, after REL-04); REL-06 Cybersecurity validation and penetration testing (Cybersecurity, after nothing); REL-07 Cybersecurity case (Cybersecurity, after REL-06); REL-08 Release management and baseline procedure (Joint, after nothing); REL-09 Technical documentation index (Joint, after REL-03, REL-04); REL-10 AI Act conformity record (Machine learning, after REL-09); REL-11 Complete the safety case (Joint, after REL-05, REL-07, REL-09); REL-12 Functional safety assessment (Independent confirmation, after REL-11); REL-13 Cybersecurity assessment (Independent confirmation, after REL-07); REL-14 Release record and declaration of conformity draft (Joint, after REL-08, REL-12, REL-13).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
